COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C24 No. 20 of 2023
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mrs. Prabha Naithani, Advocate, for the
applicant.
Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate, for the
respondent.
The petitioner, who is the opposite party to
the proceedings of Original Suit No. 47 of 2023,
Jitendra Singh Negi Vs. Godavri Negi, being the
proceedings drawn by respondent under Section 13
(1) (ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, the same is
being sought to be transferred to the Family Court,
Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar, from the
Family Court, Haldwani, District Nainital.
When this matter was initially argued before
the Coordinate Bench, the Coordinate Bench was of
the view, that there could be a possibility of
settlement. Hence, the parties were directed to
participate in the proceedings through video
conferencing for making an effort for mediation.
This Court has interacted with the parties and
looking to the complexity of the relationship, and
particularly, when there happens to be an allegation
with regard to the respondent Jitendra Singh Negi,
of already having a daughter from his erstwhile
female friend, the applicant is not willing to revive
back the relationship, and similar is the response
given by the respondent, who is the plaintiff in the
proceedings under Section 13 of the Hindu
Marriage Act.
Both the parties have unanimously agreed,
that since there is no possibility of revival of the
matrimonial relationship, they both would be
agreeable that in case if the proceedings of Suit No.
47 of 2023, Jitendra Singh Negi Vs. Godavri Negi,
pending consideration before the Court of Judge
Family Court, Haldwani, District Nainital, is
transferred to the Court of Family Court, Rudrapur,
District Udham Singh Nagar, subject to the

condition, that the Family Court, Rudrapur, District
Udham Singh, may be requested to decide the
matter expeditiously, as per the provisions
contained under Section 21-B of the Hindu
Marriage Act.
Owing to the aforesaid situation as reflected
above, this Transfer Application would stand
allowed. The Original Suit No. 47 of 2023, Jitendra
Singh Negi Vs. Godavri Negi, pending
consideration before the Family Court, Haldwani,
District Nainital, is hereby transferred to the
competent Family Court, Rudrapur, District Udham
Singh Nagar. It is further requested, that the
transferred Court, of Family Court, Rudrapur,
District Udham Singh Nagar, will make all efforts
to decide the aforesaid matrimonial case, as
expeditiously as possible, but not later than the
period prescribed under Section 21-B of the Hindu
Marriage Act.
Subject to the aforesaid, the Transfer
Application would stand allowed.

Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 21.08.2023
Shiv
